candidates.source_name: Združenje bank Slovenije – GIZ (ZBS / Bank Association of Slovenia), main site
candidates.why_relevant: The single most important Slovenian banking self-regulatory/industry body. Aggregates member-bank positions, coordinates comments on national draft laws (e.g. the 2025/2026 draft act on accessibility and use of payment instruments / cash and free basic payment account package), runs the sector's training calendar and self-regulatory codes.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Scheduled crawl of section index pages (news, publications, guidelines, training calendar); parse dates + PDF links; sl and en mirrors.
candidates.discovered_via_method: seed query (sl + en) then site navigation fetch
queries_used: Združenje bank Slovenije stališče javna obravnava predlog zakona
Bank Association of Slovenia ZBS position paper consultation regulation

candidates.source_name: ZBS – Sporočila za javnost in novice (press releases & news)
candidates.why_relevant: Primary channel where ZBS publishes its coordinated positions on draft legislation, reactions to supervisory measures, and announcements of regulatory milestones to members and press. Highest-frequency signal for A3 (regulation/consultations/deadlines).
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Weekly HTML listing crawl with date-based dedup; check for RSS; store item text + linked PDFs.
queries_used: Združenje bank Slovenije stališče javna obravnava predlog zakona

candidates.source_name: ZBS – Organiziranost (committee / working-group structure)
candidates.why_relevant: Maps the ZBS committee architecture (Odbor za plačilni promet, Odbor za kartično poslovanje, Odbor za skladnost poslovanja, Odbor za preprečevanje pranja denarja, Odbor za pravna vprašanja, Odbor za informacijsko varnost, Odbor za informatiko). Each committee is a pointer to named bank experts, workstreams and the regulatory files the sector is actually working on.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Quarterly snapshot; extract committee names and any member/chair listings as an actor map seed.
candidates.discovered_via_method: direct fetch and snowball from ZBS navigation
queries_used: Bank Association of Slovenia ZBS position paper consultation regulation

candidates.source_name: ZBS – Smernice (self-regulatory guidelines)
candidates.why_relevant: Sector self-regulation: guidelines the member banks adopt collectively, often the Slovenian operational translation of EU/EBA requirements. Useful for tracking how a regulatory deadline is being implemented in practice.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Monthly listing crawl + PDF diffing against stored versions.
queries_used: Bank Association of Slovenia ZBS position paper consultation regulation

candidates.source_name: ZBS – Kodeks (code of banking conduct / good business practice)
candidates.why_relevant: Formal self-regulatory instrument binding member banks; changes to it usually follow or pre-empt regulatory pressure (consumer protection, fees, cash access).
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Low-frequency (semi-annual) PDF version check.
queries_used: Bank Association of Slovenia ZBS position paper consultation regulation

candidates.source_name: ZBS – ADR / izvensodno reševanje sporov (alternative dispute resolution scheme)
candidates.why_relevant: Association-run out-of-court dispute resolution for bank customers — a self-regulatory function created under consumer-protection law. Reports and rules indicate emerging consumer/conduct regulatory pressure points.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Annual report harvest; monitor rules-of-procedure changes.
queries_used: Bank Association of Slovenia ZBS position paper consultation regulation

candidates.source_name: ZBS Izobraževalni center – Napovednik izobraževalnih programov / Terminski plan (training calendar)
candidates.why_relevant: Training titles and dates are a leading indicator of which regulations banks must be ready for and by when (DORA, MiCA, PSD3/PSR, AML package, CRR3). Seminar agendas often state implementation deadlines explicitly.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Bi-weekly crawl of the calendar and 'Vsa izobraževanja' listing; extract title, date, lecturer, described regulation.
queries_used: ZBS izobraževanje regulativa DORA MiCA PSD3 seminar Združenje bank Slovenije 2026

candidates.source_name: ZBS – Programi za prijavo (training registration portal)
candidates.why_relevant: Structured per-programme pages (agenda, target audience, dates) — usually richer and more machine-readable than the marketing calendar page.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Crawl listing pages only; do not register or submit forms.
queries_used: ZBS izobraževanje regulativa DORA MiCA PSD3 seminar Združenje bank Slovenije 2026

candidates.source_name: ZBS – Članice (member list of Slovenian banks and savings banks)
candidates.why_relevant: Canonical, association-maintained roster of Slovenian banks, savings banks and branches of foreign banks — the firm-level pointer set for the whole SI banking cell, and a cross-check against the Banka Slovenije register.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Quarterly scrape of names + URLs into the actor map; diff for entries/exits (M&A signal).
queries_used: Bank Association of Slovenia ZBS position paper consultation regulation

candidates.source_name: Bančni vestnik (ZBS banking journal)
candidates.why_relevant: Long-running association-published professional journal; carries analytical articles by bank and supervisor staff on incoming regulation, often the most detailed Slovenian-language commentary available on implementation timing.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Harvest tables of contents and abstracts only; do not redistribute full articles.
queries_used: Bank Association of Slovenia ZBS position paper consultation regulation

candidates.source_name: ZBS Annual Report series (Letno poročilo)
candidates.why_relevant: Annual reports enumerate which legislative files the association worked on, which committees met, and which consultations it responded to during the year — an authoritative retrospective index of regulatory activity.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Annual PDF harvest; extract the legislative-work chapter.
queries_used: Bank Association of Slovenia ZBS position paper consultation regulation

candidates.source_name: EBA consultation response repository – Bank Association of Slovenia submissions
candidates.why_relevant: ZBS files formal comment letters to EBA consultations (confirmed examples: CP50, and comments on the Guidelines on loan origination and monitoring, Sep 2019). These are the association's most explicit, citable regulatory positions and reveal member-bank pain points.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Query EBA consultation pages for uploaded response PDFs filtered on 'Slovenia'/'ZBS'; also monitor EBA consultation deadlines directly.
candidates.discovered_via_method: web search (en), snowballed from ZBS name
queries_used: Bank Association of Slovenia ZBS position paper consultation regulation

candidates.source_name: European Banking Federation – Slovenia country page (ZBS as national member)
candidates.why_relevant: Confirms ZBS's EBF membership and gives a stable English-language profile plus contact/leadership pointers; EBF positions are the umbrella under which ZBS often aligns, so EBF position papers are a proxy for the SI association line.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Low-frequency snapshot; use as actor-map anchor and to discover ZBS representatives in EBF committees.
queries_used: Bank Association of Slovenia ZBS position paper consultation regulation

candidates.source_name: Gospodarska zbornica Slovenije (GZS) – Sekcije / branch associations index
candidates.why_relevant: Master index of GZS branch chambers and sections; the route to the finance-adjacent and digital bodies (accounting services chamber, insurance brokers association, IT & telecoms association, cybersecurity section). GZS is a standard consultee on business-affecting draft legislation.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: One-off structural crawl to enumerate sections, then targeted monitoring of the finance/ICT ones.
queries_used: GZS fintech sekcija plačilne storitve regulativa zbornica

candidates.source_name: GZS – Združenje za informatiko in telekomunikacije (ZIT)
candidates.why_relevant: The GZS body that speaks for IT/technology vendors, including those supplying banking and payment infrastructure. Comments on digital, e-invoicing, AI and cyber regulation; publishes 'Koristni dokumenti' including reference price lists useful for vendor-market context.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Monthly crawl of news + documents pages.
queries_used: GZS fintech sekcija plačilne storitve regulativa zbornica

candidates.source_name: GZS – Sekcija za kibernetsko varnost (Cybersecurity Section)
candidates.why_relevant: Industry forum on NIS2 / cyber-resilience implementation in Slovenia; relevant to DORA-adjacent obligations on financial entities and their ICT providers, and typically announces compliance deadlines to members.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Monthly news/event page crawl.
queries_used: GZS fintech sekcija plačilne storitve regulativa zbornica

candidates.source_name: GZS – Zbornica računovodskih servisov (Accounting Services Chamber)
candidates.why_relevant: Aggregates the profession most exposed to payment/e-invoicing/tax-reporting rule changes; issues member circulars on new obligations and effective dates, often earlier and more concretely than banks do.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Monthly crawl of public news; do not attempt member-only areas.
queries_used: GZS fintech sekcija plačilne storitve regulativa zbornica

candidates.source_name: Trgovinska zbornica Slovenije (TZS) – Slovenian Chamber of Commerce (retail/trade)
candidates.why_relevant: Represents merchants — the acceptance side of payments. Positions on interchange fees, surcharging, card acceptance costs, cash-handling obligations and the cash-accessibility bill are the counterweight to ZBS positions; its legislation section tracks trade-law deadlines.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Bi-weekly crawl of /sl/aktualno/novice and the legislation content section.
queries_used: Trgovinska zbornica Slovenije kartično poslovanje provizije trgovci stališče gotovina

candidates.source_name: AmCham Slovenia – Finance Committee
candidates.why_relevant: Cross-industry advocacy committee focused on the tax and financial environment; AmCham runs formal advocacy positions and its member list points to international banks, payment firms and advisers active in SI. Bilingual (en/sl) output eases monitoring.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Monthly crawl of advocacy pages + member list snapshot as an actor pointer.
queries_used: AmCham Slovenia committee financial services fintech regulation working group

candidates.source_name: Digitalna koalicija Slovenije – Delovne skupine (working groups)
candidates.why_relevant: National multi-stakeholder digital coalition whose working groups (incl. a blockchain working group uniting Blockchain Think Tank Slovenije, Blockchain Alliance Europe and Bitcoin društvo Slovenije) coordinate industry input into digital/crypto legislation. Strong pointer into the SI fintech self-organisation layer.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: One-off structural crawl to enumerate working groups and member organisations, then quarterly refresh.
queries_used: "Blockchain Alliance Europe" OR "Bitcoin društvo Slovenije" MiCA zakonodaja stališče Slovenija

candidates.source_name: Blockchain Alliance Europe (Slovenia-based crypto/blockchain industry association)
candidates.why_relevant: Non-profit association of blockchain/crypto companies that explicitly cooperates with Slovenian government bodies on relevant legislation; actively lobbied on the 2025 crypto capital-gains tax proposal and on MiCA/CASP implementation. Primary self-organised voice for the crypto-payments segment.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Monthly news crawl; also monitor its LinkedIn page for position statements.
queries_used: "Blockchain Alliance Europe" OR "Bitcoin društvo Slovenije" MiCA zakonodaja stališče Slovenija
slovensko fintech združenje kriptovalute blockchain asociacija Slovenija plačila

candidates.source_name: Bitcoin društvo Slovenije (Bitcoin Association of Slovenia)
candidates.why_relevant: Self-declared purpose includes actively participating in shaping national and EU legislation; publicly opposed the Ministry of Finance's proposed 25% crypto gains tax (2025), which was subsequently shelved. Useful early-warning source for SI crypto-asset regulation and its political viability.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Monthly news crawl; treat as advocacy (biased) source, cross-check against Ministry of Finance.
queries_used: slovensko fintech združenje kriptovalute blockchain asociacija Slovenija plačila

candidates.source_name: Slovensko zavarovalno združenje, GIZ (SZZ – Slovenian Insurance Association)
candidates.why_relevant: The insurance-sector counterpart to ZBS; same GIZ (economic interest grouping) model. Runs statutory training/certification for insurance intermediaries, acts as an information centre with statistics, and responds to financial-sector legislation (IDD, consumer protection, sustainable finance) — relevant where bancassurance and financial-conglomerate supervision overlap with banking.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Monthly news + training calendar crawl; sl and en versions.
queries_used: "Slovensko zavarovalno združenje" OR "ZDU-GIZ" združenje družb za upravljanje regulativa stališča

candidates.source_name: Državni zbor / e-Demokracija consultation trail carrying association submissions (pointer to who responded)
candidates.why_relevant: Parliamentary and public-consultation records name the interested-public bodies that filed comments (associations such as ZBS, VZMD, GZS, TZS) and carry their submitted texts — the way to catch association positions that never appear on the association's own site. VZMD's repeated submissions on bank-related bills are a documented example.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Filter legislative dossiers on finance-committee (Odbor za finance) items; extract 'zainteresirana javnost' submissions.
queries_used: Združenje bank Slovenije stališče javna obravnava predlog zakona

candidates.source_name: VZMD – Vseslovensko združenje malih delničarjev/deležnikov (All-Slovenian Shareholders' Association)
candidates.why_relevant: A persistently active self-organised stakeholder association in Slovenian banking legislation (notably the bail-in / qualified bank liabilities compensation laws). Publishes its own submissions to Parliament, giving visibility into consultation timing and the opposing side of bank-sector positions.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Monthly news crawl filtered on banking keywords; treat as advocacy source.
queries_used: Združenje bank Slovenije stališče javna obravnava predlog zakona

negative_findings.description: No dedicated fintech/payments section within GZS was found. Searching the GZS section index and the seed query 'GZS fintech sekcija plačilne storitve regulativa' surfaced only ICT/telecom, cybersecurity, accounting-services and insurance-brokers bodies — no 'Sekcija za fintech' or 'Združenje za plačilne storitve'.
negative_findings.result_summary: GZS appears to have no fintech- or payments-specific section; payments advocacy sits with ZBS instead, digital topics with ZIT/SEKV.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Avoids a wasted monitoring slot and confirms ZBS is the near-monopoly association channel for SI payments regulation.

negative_findings.description: No standalone Slovenian fintech industry association (an equivalent of e.g. Fintech Latvija or a 'Fintech Slovenija' body) was located in either Slovenian or English searches. The nearest self-organised industry structures are crypto/blockchain-focused (Blockchain Alliance Europe, Blockchain Think Tank Slovenije, Bitcoin društvo Slovenije) coordinating via the Digitalna koalicija working group.
negative_findings.result_summary: Search returned foreign fintech associations and Slovenian crypto bodies, but no SI-wide fintech association.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Means fintech-side positions on PSD3/PSR/instant payments must be picked up from ZBS, individual firms, or the blockchain associations, not from a single trade body.

negative_findings.description: ZBS does not appear to maintain a public, structured archive of its national consultation responses ('odzivi na javno obravnavo'); positions surface as press releases, media quotes from the director, or as text in annual reports. Its formal comment letters are, however, publicly archived on the EBA side.
negative_findings.result_summary: No dedicated 'stališča/odzivi' index page found on zbs-giz.si.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Collection must combine the ZBS news feed, ZBS annual reports, EBA response uploads, and parliamentary dossiers rather than relying on one association page.

negative_findings.description: Bančni vestnik full-text access and the 'Programi za prijavo' portal's listing depth were not tested; member-only areas on TZS and Zbornica računovodskih servisov were not probed.
negative_findings.result_summary: Access status recorded as unverified rather than open or paywalled.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: A deterministic liveness/access pass must confirm before these are scheduled for collection.

negative_findings.description: For AmCham Slovenia's committee structure no Slovenian-language terminology was used: the advocacy pages surfaced in English only ('Finance Committee', 'Investment Committee'). Slovenian equivalents ('odbor za finance') collide with the parliamentary committee of the same name and are noisy.
negative_findings.result_summary: English-only coverage for this one actor; term flagged as noisy.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Local-language monitoring rules for AmCham need a disambiguated query pattern (site-restricted) to avoid parliamentary false positives.

coverage_gaps.description: Association-side coverage of the savings-bank/cooperative segment (Delavska hranilnica, Deželna banka Slovenije and any 'Združenje hranilnic' style grouping) was not separately investigated; they may act through ZBS or through a distinct grouping.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Crawl the ZBS Članice page and check whether savings banks have their own interest grouping; search 'združenje hranilnic Slovenije' and 'zadružna banka'.

coverage_gaps.description: Association for fund management companies (ZDU-GIZ / Združenje družb za upravljanje investicijskih skladov) and any leasing association were not resolved to a live site — the query returned only insurance-association results.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Run targeted sl queries 'Združenje družb za upravljanje investicijskih skladov GIZ' and 'Združenje leasing podjetij Slovenije' and check AJPES/business registers for the legal entity and its web domain.

coverage_gaps.description: Association LinkedIn and X/Facebook channels were not systematically catalogued, yet Slovenian associations (Blockchain Alliance Europe, SZZ, TZS, AmCham) publish positions and event announcements there first.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Add a social-channel register per association and decide on a compliant collection method (public page reads only, no scraping of logged-in surfaces).

coverage_gaps.description: No RSS/Atom feed or structured API was confirmed for any association in this cell; all monitoring designs currently assume HTML listing crawls.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Probe /feed, /rss, and sitemap.xml on zbs-giz.si, tzslo.si, gzs.si and amcham.si during the deterministic verification pass.

coverage_gaps.description: Historical depth of ZBS news and training archives (how far back listings paginate) was not established, so backfill feasibility for multi-year deadline analysis is unknown.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Test pagination depth on the ZBS news and 'Vsa izobraževanja' listings and check web.archive.org coverage for zbs-giz.si.

coverage_gaps.description: Bilateral chambers other than AmCham (German-Slovenian AHK, British-Slovenian, French-Slovenian) were not searched; these sometimes host finance/tax working groups that comment on financial regulation.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Run a follow-up sweep for 'Slovensko-nemška gospodarska zbornica' and equivalents, filtering for finance or tax committees.

brief: Slovenia's association layer for banking and payments is highly concentrated: Združenje bank Slovenije (ZBS-GIZ) is effectively the single self-regulatory and advocacy channel for banks, combining coordinated positions on draft legislation (e.g. the 2025/26 cash-accessibility and free basic payment account bill), a rich committee structure covering payments, cards, compliance, AML and information security, a self-regulatory code and guidelines, an ADR scheme, the Bančni vestnik journal, and a training calendar that functions as a leading indicator of regulatory deadlines. ZBS does not publish a structured archive of its consultation responses, so its positions must be reconstructed from its news feed, annual reports, EBA-hosted comment letters, and parliamentary consultation dossiers. Beyond ZBS, coverage is fragmented: GZS has no fintech or payments section (only ICT, cybersecurity and accounting-services bodies), no national fintech trade body appears to exist, and the self-organised digital/crypto voice sits with Blockchain Alliance Europe, Bitcoin društvo Slovenije and the Digitalna koalicija working groups. Counterweight and adjacent bodies worth tracking are Trgovinska zbornica Slovenije (merchant/acceptance side), Slovensko zavarovalno združenje (insurance, bancassurance overlap), AmCham Slovenia's Finance Committee, and advocacy groups such as VZMD that surface in parliamentary records.
